preimage.objective: Reconcile and post the authorized invoice.

procedure.name: Reconcile and post the authorized invoice.
procedure.objective: Reconcile and post the authorized invoice.
procedure.summary: Read supplementary batches without mutation; independently validate the case-level approved rule, perform one scoped action, and verify its outcome.

scope.eligible_cases: Authorized invoice records with an independently sourced identifier
excluded_cases: Records outside the approved identifier scope

boundaries.end: Hand off verified invoice and purchase-order reconciliation to an owner

steps.label: Compute invoice variance
steps.description: Subtract the authoritative purchase-order amount from the invoice amount in USD without rounding.
steps.expected_result: Zero variance is eligible for the approved matching rule.

steps.label: Decide
steps.description: Apply the approved identifier-presence rule.
steps.expected_result: The authorized step completes or the case pauses.

steps.label: Done
steps.description: Request owner-controlled assessment only after independently verifying the case-level mutation.
steps.expected_result: The authorized step completes or the case pauses.

steps.label: Inner
steps.description: Inspect at most two supplementary records; no mutation occurs in this loop.
steps.expected_result: The authorized step completes or the case pauses.

repeat.termination_description: Complete all items or pause on any uncertainty.

steps.label: Inner Done
steps.description: Return the read-only supplementary inspection result for this iteration.
steps.expected_result: The supplementary record was inspected; no mutation or verification is claimed.

steps.label: Inner Pause
steps.description: Pause the record on uncertainty without replay.
steps.expected_result: The authorized step completes or the case pauses.

steps.label: Inspect supplementary record
steps.description: Read a supplementary record without mutation; pause on uncertainty.
steps.expected_result: Supplementary inspection completes or pauses.

steps.label: Outer
steps.description: Inspect supplementary records only; no mutation or completeness claim depends on this collection.
steps.expected_result: The authorized step completes or the case pauses.

repeat.termination_description: Complete all items or pause on any uncertainty.

steps.label: Outer Done
steps.description: Return the batch and its completed record results.
steps.expected_result: The authorized step completes or the case pauses.

steps.label: Outer Pause
steps.description: Pause the batch on uncertainty.
steps.expected_result: The authorized step completes or the case pauses.

steps.label: Pause
steps.description: Pause for authorized review.
steps.expected_result: The authorized step completes or the case pauses.

steps.label: Post
steps.description: Submit the scoped record update under the applicable approval policy.
steps.expected_result: The authorized step completes or the case pauses.

steps.label: Read
steps.description: Read the authoritative invoice and matched purchase-order totals in USD. This case-level read and approved rule independently decide whether mutation is safe, even when supplementary collections are empty.
steps.expected_result: The authorized step completes or the case pauses.

steps.label: Verify
steps.description: Independently read back and verify the record update.
steps.expected_result: The authorized step completes or the case pauses.

postconditions.description: Each submitted record mutation is independently confirmed by authoritative readback.
